The second caption's italic is asked for only in the speaker label 'CAPTION (italic, the words no rider spoke)'. script_pipeline.py keeps that label as plain text, and the compositor italicises only text wrapped in *markers* (compositor._lettering_runs). The line will probably letter in roman unless the script wraps the copy itself in *...*. The '(separate, weighted)' labels in 9.3 and 12.5 have the same problem.

The approved Ponnan sheet (14-ponnan-v15.png) shows a red gold-trimmed tunic, a broad red drape and a gold-bordered dhoti. Every Ponnan panel (2.1, 2.4, 3.3, 4.3, 5.1) will fight its attached sheet. Align the sheet or the bible entry before generating, or accept per-panel overrides.

'Wide, half the page' gives layout_fit a 0.5 size floor but not a solo row: only 'full width' or strip/tier/splash words do that. The fitter may therefore pair 3.4 with another panel in a half-width slot (4.1 and 7.3 have the same wording). Adding 'full width' to the script is not a fix either, because the pipeline would then ask for a 3:1 strip, the problem described for 6.5. If these must span the column at half height, the layout has to be pinned. The script's 'generated at its placed aspect ratio' is not carried into the image_gen args, which have no aspect parameter, so these go at the default 3:2. That suits a full-width half page.
The compositor has no inset overlay: layout_fit treats inset panels as ordinary row panels. 6.3 and 6.4 will therefore be laid out as their own row slots, not inside 6.5's upper band. See 6.5.

Two layout problems the prompt cannot fix. (1) The pipeline has no inset overlay: layout_fit treats 'Inset' panels as ordinary row panels, so 6.3 and 6.4 will not sit in 6.5's upper band. The open upper third of 6.5 will just be sky, which is still usable for its three balloons. (2) 'Full width' makes the pipeline add a 3:1 FRAME SHAPE, while the script sizes 6.5 at the lower half of the page: about 1.4:1, with the row floored at 45 percent of the story height. The fitter will crop roughly half the width away (MIN_KEEP 0.45 permits it), and the print will need the 2x upscale. The script's 'generated at its placed aspect ratio' is not implemented, because the image_gen args carry no aspect parameter.
